rca_of_the_issue: Bug A RCA: legacy SPOT applied default $1200/$1800 die via spot_r1_5.jsx L3866-3883 React useEffect that ran on the active BOM item. Cloud port retained the useEffect but it only fired for the currently-viewed BOM tab, so items 2..N of a Multi-Part quote never received the default die — silently dropping ~$6,900 in revenue from the L'Oreal quote. Fix: moved the auto-die rule into backend engine.runner.build_prod_inputs so it executes for every component during the Multi-Part aggregator loop, regardless of which tab the user has visited. Mitigation verified: 6 unit tests + 4 HTTP e2e tests + 1 aggregator test all PASS, covering Crest default ($1380), Bobst default ($2070), CAD no-fire, user-supplied die preserved, user-Amortize preserved, and 5-component aggregate.
